rationale: Three-phase currents computed as V_ll/(sqrt(3)*|Z_total|) with Z_total = source + transformer + feeder up to each fault point (near 0.2 km, mid 4.0 km, remote 8.0 km). Max 3-phase = 9.304 kA at the near bus; two-phase = sqrt(3)/2 of three-phase, giving min 2-phase = 1.508 kA at the remote end. Required breaker rating = 9.304*1.1 = 10.234 kA -> smallest standard rating 12.5 kA. Relay pickup must be >= 360*1.25 = 450 A and <= 1508.11/2.0 = 754.05 A; selected 450 A.
